# Financial Modeling

## When to use
Use when the task requires calculate net-income and break-even scenarios with transparent assumptions and hours.

## Procedure
Use `python scripts/ioi.py finance --help`; model low/base/high volumes, fees, unit costs, monthly costs, taxes when grounded, hours. Define assumptions and currency and exchange date. Compute break-even units, net profit, sensitivity, effective hourly. Never label illustrative outputs as observed results.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
